import pytest
from semverrange import satisfies


class TestVersionParsing:
    """Test version parsing and validation."""

    def test_valid_simple_version(self):
        """Simple versions should parse correctly."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "0.0.0")
        assert satisfies("10.20.30", "10.20.30")

    def test_leading_v(self):
        """Leading 'v' should be allowed."""
        assert satisfies("v1.2.3", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "v1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("v1.2.3", "v1.2.3")

    def test_whitespace_trimming(self):
        """Surrounding whitespace should be ignored."""
        assert satisfies("  1.2.3  ", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "  1.2.3  ")
        assert satisfies("  v1.2.3  ", "1.2.3")

    def test_prerelease_versions(self):
        """Prerelease versions should parse correctly."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha.1", "1.0.0-alpha.1")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-0", "1.0.0-0")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-x.7.z.92", "1.0.0-x.7.z.92")

    def test_build_metadata(self):
        """Build metadata should be ignored."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0+build", "1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1.0.0+build")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0+build.123", "1.0.0+build.456")

    def test_prerelease_and_build(self):
        """Prerelease and build metadata together."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha+build", "1.0.0-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha+build1", "1.0.0-alpha+build2")

    def test_invalid_version_missing_parts(self):
        """Versions must have MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_leading_zeros(self):
        """Parts must not have leading zeros."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("01.2.3", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.02.3", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.03", "*")
        # But 0 alone is fine
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "0.0.0")

    def test_invalid_version_prerelease_leading_zeros(self):
        """Numeric prerelease identifiers must not have leading zeros."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.0.0-01", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.0.0-alpha.01", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_empty_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease cannot be empty."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.0.0-", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_too_many_parts(self):
        """Version cannot have more than MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3.4", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_non_numeric_parts(self):
        """MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH must be numeric."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("a.b.c", "*")


class TestVersionComparison:
    """Test version ordering (SemVer 2.0.0 section 11)."""

    def test_major_comparison(self):
        """Compare MAJOR numerically."""
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">=2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", ">=2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "<2.0.0")

    def test_minor_comparison(self):
        """Compare MINOR when MAJOR is equal."""
        assert satisfies("1.1.0", ">=1.1.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", ">=1.1.0")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "<1.1.0")

    def test_patch_comparison(self):
        """Compare PATCH when MAJOR and MINOR are equal."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.1", ">=1.0.1")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", ">=1.0.1")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "<1.0.1")

    def test_prerelease_lower_than_release(self):
        """Prerelease version < same version without prerelease."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", ">=1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", ">1.0.0-alpha")

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "version,range",
        [
            ("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0-beta"),
            ("1.0.0-alpha.1", "<1.0.0-alpha.2"),
            ("1.0.0-1", "<1.0.0-2"),
            ("1.0.0-1", "<1.0.0-alpha"),  # numeric < non-numeric
            ("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0-beta"),
        ],
    )
    def test_prerelease_comparison(self, version, range):
        """Test prerelease identifier comparison."""
        assert satisfies(version, range)

    def test_prerelease_fewer_identifiers_lower(self):
        """Prerelease with fewer identifiers is lower."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0-alpha.1")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-alpha.1", "<1.0.0-alpha")


class TestExactMatch:
    """Test exact version matching."""

    def test_exact_match(self):
        """Exact match with = operator."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "=1.2.3")

    def test_exact_match_no_operator(self):
        """Exact match with no operator."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3")

    def test_exact_match_whitespace(self):
        """Exact match with whitespace."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "= 1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "  =  1.2.3  ")

    def test_exact_mismatch(self):
        """Should not match different versions."""
        assert not satisfies("1.2.4", "1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.3", "1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("2.2.3", "1.2.3")


class TestPrimitiveComparators:
    """Test <, <=, >, >= operators."""

    def test_less_than(self):
        """< operator."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.2", "<1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3", "<1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.4", "<1.2.3")

    def test_less_than_or_equal(self):
        """<= operator."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.2", "<=1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "<=1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.4", "<=1.2.3")

    def test_greater_than(self):
        """> operator."""
        assert not satisfies("1.2.2", ">1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3", ">1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", ">1.2.3")

    def test_greater_than_or_equal(self):
        """>= operator."""
        assert not satisfies("1.2.2", ">=1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", ">=1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", ">=1.2.3")

    def test_comparator_with_whitespace(self):
        """Operator may be followed by whitespace."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", ">= 1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", "> 1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.2", "< 1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.2", "<= 1.2.3")


class TestXRanges:
    """Test x-ranges and partial versions."""

    def test_asterisk_matches_any(self):
        """* should match any version."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "*")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "*")
        assert satisfies("100.200.300", "*")

    def test_x_matches_any(self):
        """x should match any version."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "x")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "x")

    def test_capital_x_matches_any(self):
        """X should match any version."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "X")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "X")

    def test_empty_range_matches_any(self):
        """Empty range should match any version."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "")

    def test_partial_major_only(self):
        """1 means >=1.0.0 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "1")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "1")
        assert not satisfies("0.9.9", "1")

    def test_partial_major_minor(self):
        """1.2 means >=1.2.0 <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.99", "1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.9", "1.2")

    def test_explicit_x_minor(self):
        """1.x means >=1.0.0 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1.x")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "1.x")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "1.x")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "1.x")

    def test_explicit_x_patch(self):
        """1.2.x means >=1.2.0 <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "1.2.x")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "1.2.x")
        assert satisfies("1.2.99", "1.2.x")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "1.2.x")

    def test_capital_x_works(self):
        """Capital X should work too."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "1.2.X")
        assert satisfies("1.5.5", "1.X")

    def test_greater_than_x_range(self):
        """>1 and >1.x bump the version."""
        # >1 means >=2.0.0
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">1")
        assert not satisfies("1.9.9", ">1")
        # >1.x also means >=2.0.0
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">1.x")
        assert not satisfies("1.9.9", ">1.x")

    def test_greater_than_partial_patch(self):
        """>1.2 means >=1.3.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.3.0", ">1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.3.5", ">1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.9", ">1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.0", ">1.2")

    def test_greater_than_equal_partial(self):
        """>=1.2 means >=1.2.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", ">=1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", ">=1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.9", ">=1.2")

    def test_less_than_partial(self):
        """<1.2 means <1.2.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.1.9", "<1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.0", "<1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.0-0", "<1.2")

    def test_less_than_equal_partial(self):
        """<=1.2 means <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "<=1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "<=1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "<=1.2")

    def test_greater_than_asterisk_matches_nothing(self):
        """>* should match nothing."""
        assert not satisfies("0.0.0", ">*")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3", ">*")
        assert not satisfies("999.999.999", ">*")

    def test_less_than_asterisk_matches_nothing(self):
        """<* should match nothing."""
        assert not satisfies("0.0.0", "<*")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3", "<*")
        assert not satisfies("999.999.999", "<*")


class TestTildeRanges:
    """Test tilde ranges (~)."""

    def test_tilde_with_patch(self):
        """~1.2.3 means >=1.2.3 <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "~1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", "~1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.99", "~1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "~1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.9", "~1.2.3")

    def test_tilde_with_minor(self):
        """~1.2 means >=1.2.0 <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "~1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "~1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.99", "~1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "~1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.9", "~1.2")

    def test_tilde_with_major_only(self):
        """~1 means >=1.0.0 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "~1")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "~1")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "~1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "~1")
        assert not satisfies("0.9.9", "~1")

    def test_tilde_with_prerelease(self):
        """~1.2.3-beta.2 means >=1.2.3-beta.2 <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta.2", "~1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", "~1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3-beta.1", "~1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "~1.2.3-beta.2")


class TestCaretRanges:

        """^1.2.3 means >=1.2.3 <2.0.0-0 (MAJOR non-zero)."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "^1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "^1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", "^1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.2", "^1.2.3")

        assert satisfies("0.2.99", "^0.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("0.3.0", "^0.2.3")

        assert not satisfies("0.0.4", "^0.0.3")

    def test_caret_with_x_major_nonzero(self):

        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "^1.2.x")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.2.x")

    def test_caret_with_partial_major_nonzero(self):
        """^1.2 means >=1.2.0 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "^1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "^1.2")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.2")

    def test_caret_with_x_zero_zero(self):
        """^0.0.x means >=0.0.0 <0.1.0-0."""

        assert satisfies("0.0.5", "^0.0.x")
        assert not satisfies("0.1.0", "^0.0.x")

    def test_caret_with_partial_zero_zero(self):

        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "^0.0")
        assert satisfies("0.0.5", "^0.0")
        assert not satisfies("0.1.0", "^0.0")

    def test_caret_with_x_major(self):

        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "^1.x")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "^1.x")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.x")

        assert satisfies("0.5.0", "^0")

class TestHyphenRanges:
    """Test hyphen ranges (A - B)."""

    def test_hyphen_both_full_versions(self):
        """1.2.3 - 2.3.4 means >=1.2.3 <=2.3.4."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("2.3.4", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.2", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert not satisfies("2.3.5", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")

    def test_hyphen_left_partial(self):
        """1.2 - 2.3.4 means >=1.2.0 <=2.3.4."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "1.2 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "1.2 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("2.3.4", "1.2 - 2.3.4")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.9", "1.2 - 2.3.4")

    def test_hyphen_right_partial_minor(self):
        """1.2.3 - 2.3 means >=1.2.3 <2.4.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3 - 2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "1.2.3 - 2.3")
        assert satisfies("2.3.9", "1.2.3 - 2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.2", "1.2.3 - 2.3")
        assert not satisfies("2.4.0", "1.2.3 - 2.3")

    def test_hyphen_right_partial_major(self):
        """1.2.3 - 2 means >=1.2.3 <3.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3 - 2")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", "1.2.3 - 2")
        assert satisfies("2.9.9", "1.2.3 - 2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.2", "1.2.3 - 2")
        assert not satisfies("3.0.0", "1.2.3 - 2")


class TestComparatorSets:
    """Test comparator sets (whitespace-separated)."""

    def test_multiple_comparators_all_must_match(self):
        """Version must match every comparator in the set."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("0.9.0", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("2.1.0", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")

        assert not satisfies("1.2.2", "~1.2.0 >=1.2.3")

    def test_caret_with_other_comparators(self):
        """Caret can be combined with other conditions."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "^1.2.0 <1.6.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.0", "^1.2.0 <1.6.0")


class TestUnionRanges:
    """Test union ranges (||)."""

    def test_union_matches_first_set(self):
        """Match if first set matches."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "1.x || >=3.0.0")

    def test_union_matches_second_set(self):
        """Match if second set matches."""
        assert satisfies("3.0.0", "1.x || >=3.0.0")

    def test_union_no_match(self):
        """Don't match if neither set matches."""
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "1.x || >=3.0.0")

    def test_union_multiple_sets(self):
        """Multiple ||."""
        assert satisfies("0.5.0", "0.x || 1.x || >=2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "0.x || 1.x || >=2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", "0.x || 1.x || >=2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.5.0", "0.x || 2.x || >=3.0.0")


class TestPrereleaseRule:
    """Test prerelease matching rule."""

    def test_prerelease_no_match_without_prerelease_in_set(self):
        """Prerelease version doesn't match if no comparator has prerelease with same MMP."""
        # 1.0.0-beta doesn't match * (no prerelease in comparator)
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "*")

    def test_prerelease_no_match_without_range_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease doesn't match <2.0.0 without prerelease."""
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "<2.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_matches_with_same_mmp_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease matches comparator with same MMP and prerelease."""
        # 1.2.3-alpha.7 matches >1.2.3-alpha.3 (same MMP)
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha.7", ">1.2.3-alpha.3")

    def test_prerelease_no_match_different_mmp_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease doesn't match comparator with different MMP."""
        # 3.4.5-alpha.9 doesn't match 1.2.3-alpha.3 (different MMP)
        assert not satisfies("3.4.5-alpha.9", "1.2.3-alpha.3")

    def test_prerelease_matches_with_x_range_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease matches if set has -0 bound (from x-range) with same MMP."""
        # 1.2.3-alpha matches 1.2.x (which expands to <1.3.0-0)
        # The -0 has the same MMP, so prerelease should match
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", "1.2.x")

    def test_prerelease_matches_with_tilde_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease matches tilde range."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", "~1.2.3")

    def test_prerelease_matches_with_caret_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease matches caret range."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", "^1.2.3")

    def test_prerelease_in_union_first_set(self):
        """Prerelease in union, first set has prerelease."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "1.0.0-alpha || >=2.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_in_union_second_set(self):
        """Prerelease in union, second set doesn't have prerelease but version matches anyway."""
        # 1.0.0-beta doesn't match * but might match other sets
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "0.x || >=2.0.0")


class TestEdgeCases:
    """Test edge cases and special scenarios."""

    def test_zero_versions(self):
        """0.0.0 and related versions."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "0.0.0")
        assert satisfies("0.0.1", ">=0.0.0")
        assert satisfies("0.1.0", ">=0.0.0")

    def test_very_large_versions(self):
        """Large version numbers."""
        assert satisfies("100.200.300", "100.200.300")
        assert satisfies("100.200.300", "^100.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_numeric_comparison(self):
        """Numeric prerelease identifiers compared numerically."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-2", ">1.0.0-1")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-10", ">1.0.0-2")  # 10 > 2 numerically

    def test_prerelease_mixed_types(self):
        """Numeric prerelease identifiers are always less than non-numeric."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-1", "<1.0.0-alpha")

    """Test prerelease version matching rules."""

    def test_prerelease_no_prerelease_in_set_no_match(self):
        """Prerelease version doesn't match set without prerelease comparator."""

    def test_prerelease_matches_with_prerelease_in_set(self):
        """Prerelease version matches if set has prerelease with same MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "1.0.0-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", ">=1.0.0-alpha")

    def test_prerelease_matches_exact_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease version matches exact prerelease."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha.7", ">1.0.0-alpha.3")

    def test_prerelease_no_match_different_patch(self):
        """Prerelease doesn't match if prerelease in range has different MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH."""
        assert not satisfies("3.4.5-alpha.9", ">1.2.3-alpha.3")

    def test_prerelease_matches_with_bound_at_same_version(self):
        """Prerelease matches if range has comparator with same MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha.7", ">1.2.3-alpha.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", ">1.2.3-alpha.1")

    def test_prerelease_no_match_without_explicit_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease doesn't match ranges without prerelease specification."""
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "<2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0-rc.1", ">=1.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_matches_with_hyphen_zero_bound(self):
        """Prerelease of patch version should match -0 upper bounds."""
        # ^1.2.3 means >=1.2.3 <2.0.0-0
        # So 1.5.0-alpha should match because 1.5.0-alpha < 2.0.0
        # But with the special rule, it shouldn't match unless there's a prerelease in the range
        # Actually, let me reconsider. The spec says:
        # "A version that has a prerelease tag matches a comparator set only if,
        # in addition to matching every comparator, at least one comparator in the set
        # is a full version with a prerelease tag and the same MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH as the version."
        # This includes the -0 bounds. So <2.0.0-0 is a full version with prerelease 0 and MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH 2.0.0
        # But the version 1.5.0-alpha has MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH 1.5.0, not 2.0.0, so it doesn't match
        # Let me check: 1.2.3-alpha should match >1.2.3-alpha.3 because
        # the comparator >1.2.3-alpha.3 has the same MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", ">1.2.3-alpha.1")

    def test_prerelease_matches_less_than_bound(self):
        """Prerelease of bound version should match comparators with same MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH."""
        # <1.3.0-0 includes comparator with MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH 1.3.0
        # But 1.2.3-alpha has different MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, so shouldn't match
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", "<1.3.0")

    def test_tilde_range_with_prerelease_bound(self):
        """Tilde range creates lower bound with prerelease tag."""
        # ~1.2.3-beta.2 means >=1.2.3-beta.2 <1.3.0-0
        # The lower bound 1.2.3-beta.2 has the same MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH as the version
        # so it should match
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta.5", "~1.2.3-beta.2")

    def test_prerelease_matches_range_with_matching_patch(self):
        """Prerelease should match if any comparator has matching MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH."""
        # >=1.0.0-rc.1 <=2.0.0 includes comparator 1.0.0-rc.1 with matching MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH

# Prerelease Matching Rules
class TestPrereleaseMatching:
    """Test prerelease version matching rules."""

    def test_prerelease_matches_prerelease_comparator(self):
        # 1.2.3-alpha.7 matches >1.2.3-alpha.3 (same MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, has prerelease)
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha.7", ">1.2.3-alpha.3")

    def test_prerelease_does_not_match_different_mmp(self):
        # 3.4.5-alpha.9 does NOT match >1.2.3-alpha.3 (different MMP)
        assert not satisfies("3.4.5-alpha.9", ">1.2.3-alpha.3")

    def test_prerelease_does_not_match_asterisk(self):
        # 1.0.0-beta does NOT match *
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "*")

    def test_prerelease_does_not_match_range_without_prerelease(self):
        # 1.0.0-beta does NOT match <2.0.0 (no prerelease in comparator)
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "<2.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_matches_range_with_matching_prerelease(self):
        # 1.2.3-beta matches >=1.2.3-alpha (both have prerelease, same MMP)
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta", ">=1.2.3-alpha")

    def test_prerelease_x_range_expansion(self):
        # <1.2 expands to <1.2.0-0, should not match 1.1.999-prerelease if logic requires exact MMP
        # Actually the -0 bound is special and might match differently
        assert satisfies("1.1.999", "<1.2")

    def test_release_version_matches_all_ranges(self):
        # Release versions without prerelease should match normal ranges
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "*")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "<2.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_with_caret_range(self):
        # ^1.2.3-beta -> >=1.2.3-beta <2.0.0-0
        # The -0 bound should allow matching prerelease 1.9.9-anything
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta", "^1.2.3-beta")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9-alpha", "^1.2.3-beta")

    def test_prerelease_does_not_match_basic_range_without_prerelease(self):
        # 1.2.3-alpha should not match >1.2.2 (no prerelease comparator)
        # It should not match because there's no prerelease version in the comparator set
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", ">1.2.2")
